surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism during the O2-plasma-assisted ALD of TiO2 involves both surface -OH groups and carbonates as reactive sites for TTIP chemisorption. The relative fraction of these sites depends on the residence time of the surface reaction products in the plasma volume.
evidence: During the ALD of TiO2, both metal carbonates and surface -OH groups have previously been reported as the reactive sites for TTIP chemisorption when using O3 and H2O, respectively, as the oxidizing agents. Our data shows that both of these reactive species are simultaneously generated during the O2-plasma cycle, which is apparent from the IR difference spectrum in Figure 1b and subsequently consumed by TTIP chemisorption in the next cycle.
